Punch-in at 0.40 is the hook-level emphasis.

segments.rationale: POINT 01 payoff — the 4.05s hold that gives phase 1 its contrast against the short hook shots; jump cut skips src 57.70-60.20 (a repeated example). Breathe keeps the frame alive under a static speaker.

segments.rationale: POINT 02 chapter change at 15.00, 10.65s after point 1 — inside the briefed 12-15s cadence. Carries its own one-sentence setup so the point works with no prior context. Phase-2 average shot length drops to 1.75s here (70% of phase 1).

effectSpecs.rationale: Emphasis accent on the 20.20 cut into the key phrase of point 2. Vignette is the correct low-motion choice (subtle, face-safe) and is a new type in the ladder, intensity 0.58.

segments.rationale: POINT 02 emphasis cut at 20.20 — the phrase the whole second point exists to deliver; jump cut drops src 149.40-151.30 (a long pause). Drift-left mirrors the earlier drift-right for variety.

segments.rationale: POINT 02 payoff clause — the sentence that makes the second point worth remembering; jump cut removes src 264.00 restatement region ahead (src 164.00 onward) later. Slow-push at 0.32 keeps the talking head intentional.

Post-climax jump cut — src 270.80-273.10 (a repeated example) removed; back to 1.00x so the ramp reads as a one-off accent, not a look. Handheld keeps momentum as shots shorten.

effectSpecs.rationale: Penultimate accent on the 38.80 cut — the last hit before the landing, 0.20s and 0.88 intensity so it reads as a jab. Brightness returns but at a different value and intensity than the 29.00 dip, so no consecutive duplicate.

segments.rationale: Penultimate jab — jump cut skips src 277.00-279.40 (filler and a breath); tilt-up lifts the eye toward the closing thought.
Final line of POINT 03, punched in so the last word of the argument lands before the held outro. Ends the dense phase-3 run: 11 shots in 11.80s versus 6 shots in 15.00s for phase 1.

effectSpecs.rationale: Landing accent on the 40.80 cut — the payoff trigger. Strongest vignette of the edit (amount 30, 0.92) closes the frame in on the speaker for the voice-only close; face-safe, no blur or glitch.

segments.rationale: Landing — the speaker's own wrap-up line from src 388.40, held 4.20s at 1.00x (longer than any earlier shot, and unslowed so the closing words stay perfectly intelligible). Pull-back eases out to the wide frame for the final beat; no music, so the voice carries the close exactly as briefed.

Landing card, 0.20s after the 40.80 cut into the 4.20s hold, fading out at 44.20 so the final 0.80s is clean picture and voice. It restates the promise from the hook line, closing the loop; 4 words needs 1.33s and it gets 3.20s. Fade is the fifth distinct animation preset.

captionTemplate.rationale: Set once so all 26 segments inherit one caption lane. Captions are transcribed word-level from video-1's OWN audio and re-timed to each segment's trimmed source range, which is what makes them both burned-in and exactly synced to the speech after the jump cuts — and it guarantees the speaker's original wording is preserved verbatim rather than paraphrased. y=0.765 sits above the 9:16 bottom-20% UI zone and below the face region; the numbered badges live at y=0.615 and the title cards at y=0.155, so the three text layers never overlap in space or time. Active-word highlight in the same #FFD84D as the point badges ties the caption lane to the numbering system.

metadata.genre: educational podcast short — numbered top-3 explainer
metadata.rationale: Spine: a two-shot cold-open promise (0.00-1.95) -> framing card that tells a first-time viewer a numbered list is coming (1.95-4.35) -> POINT 01 with its own setup sentence (4.35-15.00) -> POINT 02 (15.00-29.00) -> POINT 03 (29.00-40.80) -> held landing on the speaker's own wrap-up line (40.80-45.00). Point cadence 4.35 / 15.00 / 29.00 = roughly one point every 12-15s as briefed. Every cut is a hard cut and every source range is non-contiguous inside its own region, so filler words, breaths, long pauses and tangents are jump-cut out while the speaker's wording stays verbatim (no re-ordering of clauses, no reversed source time). Rhythm: phase 1 avg 2.50s (6 shots, incl. a 4.05s hold), phase 2 avg 1.75s (8 shots, 70% of phase 1), phase 3 avg 1.07s (11 shots, 43% of phase 1) then the 4.20s landing holds longer than any earlier shot. Treatment: ONE coherent grade for the whole edit (colorGrade contrast 1.06 / saturation 1.05 / brightness 1.01) plus 11 momentary accent hits that escalate 0.38 -> 0.92 across the three phases; because this is a talking head, all hits are grade-family only (brightness, contrast, saturation, tonal, vignette, sharpen) — no glitch, no aberration, no blur on the face. transitions[] is deliberately EMPTY: the brief says hard cuts only with no transitions, so zero rendered transitions is the correct plan. Audio: the requested 21 Savage bed sits at 0.20 under points 1 and 2 and stops dead at 29.00, the exact frame point 3 starts, so the final point and the landing play voice-only; video-1's own dialogue audio is preserved at full level on all 26 segments (no silence decision is emitted, so speech is never muted). Open captions are generated word-level from video-1's own audio via captionTemplate so the burned-in text is the speaker's exact wording, synced per segment.
